description: Retrieve detailed route information from the routes cache. Examples: Get received routes for segment 'Seg1', Find routes for connector ID 60, Search routes containing 'customer'. Returns route objects with connector details, BGP attributes, segment assignments, and inter-CXP relationships. Requires pagination for large datasets (use limit=100). For advertised routes, specify segmentName or cxp. Common combinations: type+segmentName, type+connectorId+segmentName, type+cxp.

connectorId.description: Filter by connector ID - connectors link customer networks (AWS VPCs, Azure VNets, on-premises) to Alkira (e.g., 60)

cxp.description: Filter by CXP (Cloud Exchange Point) - Alkira's PoPs in different cloud regions where connectors terminate (e.g., 'US-WEST', 'EU-CENTRAL')

entityInstance.description: Exact match for entity instance name (e.g., 'Site1', 'Joshua-VPC-1')

group.description: Filter by group routes belong to (e.g., 'routes-group1')

includeSharedRoutes.description: Include segment resource shared routes (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of routes to return per page (recommended: 100 for optimal performance)

lpmPrefix.description: Longest Prefix Match search for IP address. If connectorId provided, searches on that connector; otherwise searches across segments (e.g., '0.0.0.0', '10.1.0.0')

offset.description: Starting offset for route retrieval (pagination required for large datasets)

outputFormat.description: Output format: json, table, csv, summary (default: json)

overlapType.description: Filter by overlap type - routes with conflicting prefixes: 'OVERLAP_INVALIDATED', 'SEGSHARE_OVERLAP', 'REMOTE_CXP_OVERLAP_INVALIDATED'

prefix.description: Exact match prefix filter. Use URL encoding for '/' (e.g., '10.1.1.0%2F24' for '10.1.1.0/24')

prefixType.description: Filter by route scope: 'LOCAL' (segment-only), 'SHARED' (cross-segment via segment resource shares)

routeRecvType.description: Filter by route processing status: 'HIGH_CHURN' (suppressed/flapping), 'OVERLAP' (conflicting prefixes), 'ORIGINAL' (clean routes)

routeStatus.description: Filter by route status: active, suppressed, overlap

search.description: Search across all fields, returns routes matching the term (e.g., 'Ipsec', 'customer')

segmentId.description: Filter by segment ID (numeric identifier like 12)

segmentName.description: Filter by network segment - isolated routing domains that provide security boundaries and traffic control (e.g., 'Corporate', 'DMZ')

segmentNames.description: Comma-separated list of segment names to match against (e.g., 'seg1,seg2')

segmentResourceShare.description: Filter by segment resource share - allows selective route sharing between network segments (e.g., 'corp-dmz-share')

sourceCXP.description: Filter by source CXP for inter-CXP routes - routes redistributed between different Alkira regions

type.description: Routes type cache to pull: 'received' (routes learned by Alkira) or 'advertised' (routes Alkira advertises to connectors)

name: route_get

description: Get ALL routes with automatic pagination (handles large result sets efficiently)

outputFormat.description: Output format: json, summary, count (default: json)
